sam: Nice manifest. A few content rules from brand/legal: no numeric dollar claims, annotations must be qualitative ("lower-cost", "better tail latency"). Add footer lockup: "Redwood Inference 1 production-ready inference" and source line: "internal benchmark; illustrative". Also must include alt-text for every asset and an export-readable alt-text csv.

faye: Accessibility & technical constraints: color contrast AA for text and annotation strokes, provide a dark-mode palette pair for socials (APAC variant), ensure GIFs < 1.8MB for IG, MP4 < 3.5MB for LinkedIn. Include LQ fallback PNGs for email clients. Also provide SVG funnels with <desc> blocks and keyboard-focusable layers.

matt: Animation spec: sparkline or micro-trajectory only (12 frames loop). Keep motion subtle (no flashing). Provide both GIF and MP4; also attach a 6s MP4 for LinkedIn stories if we need it. Use frame export at 72dpi, color-reduced palette for GIFs to reduce size.

zoe: Naming & tagging policy: tag Figma frames with release/launch-inbound/2026-04-14. Also add metadata in the Figma file: "release_tag": "release/launch-inbound/2026-04-14", "asset_manifest": "MIQ_launchAPR2026_*" so automated export understands. Please ensure components are in the Marketing Design Library (tokens: type-v3, color-sys-v2).

faye: CSV/metrics note: please upload the cleaned CSV with headers model,cost_per_1000,p95_ms,tokens_sec and annotate any removed outliers. Link it here when ready. We'll plot cost_per_1000 vs p95_ms and overlay a non-quant regression line for visual guidance only.

sam: Legal quick check: we need a short disclaimer in the footer: "Internal benchmark; illustrative only. See methodology in the attached doc." No explicit SLA or savings statements. If marketing wants a quantitative callout later well route to legal.

matt: Who's owning landing thumbnail copy and SDR tile copy?

zoe: I'll own landing thumbnail copy. Sam will own SDR tile copy; Sam please post both variants (global + APAC short) in this thread.

sam: Posted copy drafts at 09:42 PT. Also adding UTM placeholder syntax for CTAs: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=launch_apr2026&utm_medium={channel}. Please bake that into CTA areas as a visible placeholder layer.

brand-bot: Automated reminder: include alt text for every exported frame, tag frames with release/launch-inbound/2026-04-14, and ensure naming matches MIQ_launchAPR2026_* for automated pulls.
